Full-stack software developer with over five years of experience building reliable, secure
applications in C# / .NET and Angular. I bring an active security perspective from bug bounty
research on Bugcrowd — hunting real-world vulnerabilities in REST APIs — a mindset that
directly shapes how I design systems, review code, and think about resilience every day.
Beyond traditional development, I am actively exploring agentic AI: building LLM-powered
automation workflows that help teams and individuals accomplish more with less friction.
I also do freelance web development and SEO consulting for marketing professionals and
businesses in Mexico, bridging technical depth with practical digital growth strategy.
As a team lead and former instructor, I communicate clearly, mentor effectively, and deliver.
Fluent in English, French, Portuguese and Spanish — I bring a genuinely international
perspective and collaborate naturally across cultures and markets.
